'''T'alla''' was a [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] when the Jedi were based on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

==Biography==
A Jedi Master from [[Nerit]], T'alla constructed a massive [[Gardens of T'alla/Legends|garden complex]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. After establishing the gardens, T'alla planted herself at the center and entered into the tree-like life-cycle of her species. Jedi gathered around the tree-form of T'alla for many millennia, growing and expanding the gardens for generations.<ref name="NoP" />
